brief:
An Israeli Arab political leader said Wednesday his party would back an opposition government aimed at removing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, though he stopped short of committing to coalition membership, Middle East Eye reported. The Joint List, a key Arab-led party, signaled willingness to provide parliamentary support for an anti-Netanyahu administration.

The conditional backing suggests potential leverage for opposition forces seeking to form a government, while the refusal to join a coalition indicates the party's wariness of direct ministerial involvement.
dek: Israeli Arab leader says party ready to back anti-Netanyahu government but not in coalition The leader of key Arab-led party Joint List said on Wednesday that he was willing to cooperate with an opposition-led government to unseat Israeli Prime Minister…
title: Arab party leader offers support to oust Netanyahu without joining cabinet
